verses.geez:
ወለእመ ፡ ሰሚዐ ፡ ሰማዕክሙ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ ወዐቀብክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትግበሩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡
                  ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዘክሙ ፡ ዮም ፡ ወይሬስየከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ [አምላክከ ፡] መልዕልተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if thou wilt indeed hear the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and do all these commands, which I charge thee this day, that the Lord thy God shall set thee on high above all the nations of the earth;

translations.lxx: And it shall come to pass, if thou wilt indeed hear the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and do all these commands, which I charge thee this day, that the Lord thy God shall set thee on high above all the nations of the earth;
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:
translations.ron: "Dacă tu, după ce vei trece peste Iordan, în pământul pe care Domnul Dumnezeul tău îi-l va da, vei asculta glasul Domnului Dumnezeului tău şi vei împlini cu băgare de seamă toate poruncile Lui pe care ţi le dau astăzi, atunci Domnul Dumnezeul tău te va pune mai presus de toate popoarele pământului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν ἀκοῇ ἀκούσῃς τῆς φωνῆς Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου, φυλάσσειν καὶ ποιεῖν πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς ταύτας, ἃς ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον, καὶ δώσει σε Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου ὑπεράνω ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τῆς γῆς,

verses.geez: ወይበጽሐከ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ በረከት ፡ ወይረክበከ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ሰማዕከ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
verses.translation: and all these blessings shall come upon thee, and shall find thee. If thou wilt indeed hear the voice of the Lord thy God,

translations.lxx: and all these blessings shall come upon thee, and shall find thee. If thou wilt indeed hear the voice of the Lord thy God,
translations.kjv: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
translations.ron: De vei asculta glasul Domnului Dumnezeului tău, vor veni asupra ta toate binecuvântările acestea şi se vor împlini asupra ta:
translations.grk: καὶ ἥξουσιν ἐπὶ σὲ πᾶσαι αἱ εὐλογίαι αὗται, καὶ εὑρήσουσί σε· ἐὰν ἀκοῇ ἀκούσῃς τῆς φωνῆς Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου,

verses.geez: ቡሩከ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በሐቅል ፡ ወቡሩከ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በሀገር ።
verses.translation: blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.

translations.lxx: blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
translations.kjv: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
translations.ron: Binecuvântat să fii în cetate şi binecuvântat să fii în ţarină;
translations.grk: εὐλογημένος σὺ ἐν πόλει, καὶ εὐλογημένος σὺ ἐν ἀγρῶ.

verses.geez:
ቡሩከ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ፍሬ ፡ ከርሥከ ፡ ወቡሩከ ፡ ይከውን ፡ እክለ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ ወአዕጻደ ፡ ላህምከ ፡ ወመራዕየ ፡
                  አባግዒከ ።
verses.translation: Blessed shall be the offspring of thy body, and the fruits of thy land, and the herds of thy oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep.

translations.lxx: Blessed shall be the offspring of thy body, and the fruits of thy land, and the herds of thy oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep.
translations.kjv: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
translations.ron: Binecuvântat să fie rodul pântecelui tău, rodul pământului tău, rodul dobitoacelor tale;
translations.grk: Εὐλογημένα τὰ ἔκγονα τῆς κοιλίας σου, καὶ τὰ γεννήματα τῆς γης σου, καὶ τὰ βουκόλια τῶν βοῶν σου, καὶ τὰ ποίμνια τῶν προβάτων σου.

verses.geez: ቡሩከ ፡ ይከውን ፡ መዛግብቲከ ፡ ወትራፋቲከ ።
verses.translation: Blessed shall be thy barns, and thy stores.

translations.lxx: Blessed shall be thy barns, and thy stores.
translations.kjv: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.
translations.ron: Binecuvântate să fie hambarele tale şi cămările tale;
translations.grk: Εὐλογημέναι αἱ ἀποθῆκαί σου, καὶ τὰ ἐγκαταλείμματά σου.

verses.geez: ቡሩከ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በበአትከ ፡ ወቡሩከ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በፀአትከ ።
verses.translation: Blessed shalt thou be in thy coming in, and blessed shalt thou be in thy going out.

translations.lxx: Blessed shalt thou be in thy coming in, and blessed shalt thou be in thy going out.
translations.kjv: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
translations.ron: Binecuvântat să fii la intrarea ta în casă şi binecuvântat să fii la ieşirea ta din casă;
translations.grk: Εὐλογημένος σὺ ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαί σε, καὶ εὐλογημένος σὺ ἐν τῷ ἐκπορεύεσθαί σε.

verses.geez:
ወያገብኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ለፀርከ ፡ [እለ ፡ ይትቃወሙከ ፡] ከመ ፡ ይትቀጥቀጡ ፡ በታሕተ ፡ እገሪከ ፡
                  በአሐቲ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ ይወፅኡ ፡ ይትቀበሉከ ፡ ወበሰብዑ ፡ ፍናዌ ፡ ይነትዑ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጽከ ።
verses.translation: The Lord deliver thine enemies that withstand thee utterly broken before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and they shall flee seven ways from before thee.

translations.lxx: The Lord deliver thine enemies that withstand thee utterly broken before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and they shall flee seven ways from before thee.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
translations.ron: Să bată Domnul înaintea ta pe vrăjmaşii tăi cei ce se vor ridica asupra ta; pe o cale să vină asupra ta şi pe şapte căi să fugă de tine;
translations.grk: Παραδῷ Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου τοὺς ἀνθεστηκότας σοι συντετριμμένους πρὸ προσώπου σου· ὁδῷ μιᾷ ἐξελεύσονται πρὸς σέ, καὶ ἐν ἑπτὰ ὁδοῖς φεύξονται ἀπὸ προσώπου σου.

verses.geez:
ወይፌኑ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በረከቶ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያቲከ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘወደይከ ፡ እዴከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡
                  እንተ ፡ ወሀበከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
verses.translation: The Lord send upon thee his blessing in thy barns, and on all on which thou shalt put thine hand, in the land which the Lord thy God gives thee.

translations.lxx: The Lord send upon thee his blessing in thy barns, and on all on which thou shalt put thine hand, in the land which the Lord thy God gives thee.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
translations.ron: Să-îi trimită Domnul binecuvântare peste grânarele tale şi peste tot lucrul mâinilor tale şi să te binecuvânteze în pământul pe care Domnul Dumnezeul tău ţi-l dă;
translations.grk: Ἀποστείλαι Κύριος ἐπὶ σὲ τὴν εὐλογίαν ἐν τοῖς ταμείοις σου, καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα οὗ ἂν ἐπιβάλῃς τὴν χεῖρά σου, ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, ἧς Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου δίδωσί σοι.

verses.geez:
ወያቀውመከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ በከመ ፡ መሐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአበዊከ ፡ (ወ)ለእመ ፡ ሰማዕከ
                  ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ወሖርከ ፡ በፍናዊሁ ፤
verses.translation: The Lord raise thee up for himself a holy people, as he sware to thy fathers; if thou wilt hear the voice of the Lord thy God, and walk in all his ways.

translations.lxx: The Lord raise thee up for himself a holy people, as he sware to thy fathers; if thou wilt hear the voice of the Lord thy God, and walk in all his ways.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.
translations.ron: Să facă Domnul Dumnezeu din tine popor sfânt al Său, precum ţi S-a jurat El ţie şi părinţilor tăi, dacă vei asculta poruncile Domnului Dumnezeului tău şi vei umbla în căile Lui;
translations.grk: Ἀναστήσαι σε Κύριος ἑαυτῷ λαὸν ἅγιον, ὃν τρόπον ὤμοσε τοῖς πατράσι σου· ἐὰν ἀκούσῃς τῆς φωνῆς Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου, καὶ πορευθῇς ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ,

verses.geez: ወይሬእየከ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ከመ ፡ ተሰምየ ፡ ስሞ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ ወይፈርሁከ ።
verses.translation: And all the nations of the earth shall see thee, that the name of the Lord is called upon thee, and they shall stand in awe of thee.

translations.lxx: And all the nations of the earth shall see thee, that the name of the Lord is called upon thee, and they shall stand in awe of thee.
translations.kjv: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
translations.ron: Vor vedea toate popoarele pământului că porţi numele Domnului Dumnezeului tău şi se vor teme de tine;
translations.grk: καὶ ὄψονταί σε πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τῆς γῆς, ὅτι τὸ ὄνομα Κυρίου ἐπικέκληταί σοι, καὶ φοβηθήσονταί σε.

verses.geez:
ወያተባዝኀከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሠናይት ፡ በውሉደ ፡ ከርሥከ ፡ ወበእክለ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ ወያስተዋልዶ ፡
                  ለእንስሳከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ መሐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአበዊከ ፡ ከመ ፡ የሀብከ ፡ ከመ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሰማይ ፡
                  ዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.translation: And the Lord thy God shall multiply thee for good in the offspring of thy body, and in the offspring of thy cattle, and in the fruits of thy land, on thy land which the Lord sware to thy fathers to give to thee.

translations.lxx: And the Lord thy God shall multiply thee for good in the offspring of thy body, and in the offspring of thy cattle, and in the fruits of thy land, on thy land which the Lord sware to thy fathers to give to thee.
translations.kjv: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
translations.ron: Domnul Dumnezeul tău îţi va da belşug în toate bunătăţile, în rodul pântecelui tău, în rodul dobitoacelor tale şi în rodul ogoarelor tale din pământul pe care Domnul S-a jurat părinţilor tăi să ţi-l dea;
translations.grk: Καὶ πληθυνεῖ σε Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου εἰς ἀγαθὰ ἐν τοῖς ἐκγόνοις τῆς κοιλίας σου, καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἐκγόνοις τῶν κτηνῶν σου, καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς γεννήμασι τῆς γῆς σου, ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς σου ἧς ὤμοσε Κύριος τοῖς πατράσι σου δοῦναί σοι.

verses.geez:
ወይፈትሕ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መዝገበ ፡ ቡሩከ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ከመ ፡ የሀብከ ፡ ዝናመ ፡ በመዋዕሊሁ ፡ ለምድርከ ፡ ከመ
                  ፡ ይባርክ ፡ ለከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ተግባረ ፡ እደዊከ ፡ ወትሌቅሕ ፡ አንተ ፡ ለብዙኅ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወአንተሰ ፡ ኢትትሌቃሕ ፡
                  ወትኴንን ፡ አንተ ፡ ለብዙኅ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወለከሰ ፡ ኢይኴንኑከ ።
verses.translation: May the Lord open to thee his good treasure, the heaven, to give rain to thy land in season: may he bless all the works of thy hands: so shalt thou lend to many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt rule over many nations, but they shall not rule over thee.

translations.lxx: May the Lord open to thee his good treasure, the heaven, to give rain to thy land in season: may he bless all the works of thy hands: so shalt thou lend to many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt rule over many nations, but they shall not rule over thee.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
translations.ron: Domnul îţi va deschide comoara Sa cea bună, cerul, ca să dea ploaie pământului tău la vreme şi ca să binecuvânteze toate lucrurile mâinilor tale; şi vei da împrumut multor popoare, iar tu nu vei lua împrumut; vei domni peste multe popoare, iar acelea nu vor domni peste tine;
translations.grk: Ἀνοίξαι σοι Κύριος τὸν θησαυρὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀγαθὸν, τὸν οὐρανὸν, δοῦναι τὸν ὑετὸν τῇ γῇ σου ἐπὶ καιροῦ· εὐλογῆσαι πάντα τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου· καὶ δανειεῖς ἔθνεσι πολλοῖς, σὺ δὲ οὐ δανειῇ. καὶ ἄρξεις σὺ ἐθνῶν πολλῶν, σοῦ δὲ οὐκ ἄρξουσι.

verses.geez:
ወይሠይመከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእስ ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዘነብ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ወኢትከውን ፡ መትሕተ
                  ፡ ለእመ ፡ ሰማዕክሙ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ ወትእዛዞ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዘክሙ ፡ ዮም ፡ ከመ ፡ ትዕቀቡ
                  ፡ ወትግበሩ ፤
verses.translation: The Lord thy God make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt then be above and thou shalt not be below, if thou wilt hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, in all things that I charge thee this day to observe.

translations.lxx: The Lord thy God make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt then be above and thou shalt not be below, if thou wilt hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, in all things that I charge thee this day to observe.
translations.kjv: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
translations.ron: Domnul Dumnezeul tău te va pune cap iar nu coadă şi vei fi numai sus, iar jos nu vei fi, dacă te vei supune poruncilor Domnului Dumnezeului tău, care ţi le spun eu astăzi să le ţii şi să le împlineşti
translations.grk: Καταστήσαι σε Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου εἰς κεφαλὴν καὶ μὴ εἰς οὐρὰν, καὶ ἔσῃ τότε ἐπάνω καὶ οὐκ ἔσῃ ὑποκάτω, ἐὰν ἀκούσῃς τῆς φωνῆς Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου, ὅσα ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον φυλάσσειν.

verses.geez:
ወኢትትገሐሡ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ቃል ፡ ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዘከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ኢለየማን ፡ ወኢለፀጋም ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሑሩ ፡ ድኅረ ፡
                  አማልክተ ፡ ባዕድ ፡ ታምልክዎሙ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt not turn aside from any of the commandments, which I charge thee this day, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt not turn aside from any of the commandments, which I charge thee this day, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
translations.ron: Şi dacă nu te vei abate de la toate poruncile care ţi le poruncesc eu astăzi nici la dreapta nici la stânga, ca să mergeţi după alţi dumnezei să le slujiţi.
translations.grk: Οὐ παραβήσῃ ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν ἐντολῶν, ὧν ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον δεξιὰ οὐδὲ ἀριστερὰ, πορεύσεθαι ὀπίσω θεῶν ἑτέρων λατρεύειν αὐτοῖς.

verses.geez:
ወለእመ ፡ ኢሰማዕክሙ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትዕቀቡ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዘክሙ ፡
                  ዮም ፡ ወይመጽእ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ መርገም ፡ ወይረክበከ ።
verses.translation: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe all his commandments, as many as I charge thee this day, then all these curses shall come on thee, and overtake thee.

translations.lxx: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe all his commandments, as many as I charge thee this day, then all these curses shall come on thee, and overtake thee.
translations.kjv: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:
translations.ron: Iar dacă nu vei asculta glasul Domnului Dumnezeului tău şi nu te vei sili să împlineşti toate poruncile şi hotărârile Lui pe care îi le poruncesc eu astăzi, să vină asupra ta toate blestemele acestea şi să te ajungă:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν μὴ εἰσακούσῃς τῆς φωνῆς Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου, φυλάσσεσθαι πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ, ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον, καὶ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ σὲ πᾶσαι αἱ κατάραι αὗται, καὶ καταλήψονταί σε.

verses.geez: ወትከውን ፡ ርጉመ ፡ አንተ ፡ በሐቅል ፡ ወበሀገር ።
verses.translation: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.

translations.lxx: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.
translations.kjv: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.
translations.ron: Blestemat să fii tu în cetate şi blestemat să fii tu în ţarină;
translations.grk: Ἐπικατάρατος σὺ ἐν πόλει, καὶ ἐπικατάρατος σὺ ἐν ἀγρῷ.

verses.geez: ወይከውን ፡ ርጉመ ፡ መዛግብቲከ ፡ ወትራፋቲከ ፤
verses.translation: Cursed shall be thy barns and thy stores.

translations.lxx: Cursed shall be thy barns and thy stores.
translations.kjv: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.
translations.ron: Blestemate să fie grânarele tale şi cămările tale;
translations.grk: Ἐπικατάρατοι αἱ ἀποθῆκαί σου, καὶ τὰ ἐγκαταλείμματά σου.

verses.geez: ወርጉመ ፡ ውሉደ ፡ ከርሥከ ፡ ወእክለ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ ወአዕጻዳተ ፡ አልህምቲከ ፡ ወመራዕየ ፡ አባግዒከ ።
verses.translation: Cursed shall be the offspring of thy body, and the fruits of thy land, the herds of thine oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep.

translations.lxx: Cursed shall be the offspring of thy body, and the fruits of thy land, the herds of thine oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep.
translations.kjv: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
translations.ron: Blestemat să fie rodul pântecelui tău şi rodul pământului tău, rodul vacilor tale şi rodul oilor tale;
translations.grk: Ἐπικατάρατα τὰ ἔκγονα τῆς κοιλίας σου, καὶ τὰ γεννήματα τῆς γῆς σου, τὰ βουκόλια τῶν βοῶν σου, καὶ τὰ ποίμνια τῶν προβάτων σου·

verses.geez: ወርጉም ፡ አንተ ፡ በበአትከ ፡ ወበፀአትከ ፡ ርጉመ ፡ ትከውን ።
verses.translation: Cursed shalt thou be in thy coming in, and cursed shalt thou be in thy going out.

translations.lxx: Cursed shalt thou be in thy coming in, and cursed shalt thou be in thy going out.
translations.kjv: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
translations.ron: Blestemat să fii tu la intrarea ta în casă şi blestemat la ieşirea ta din casă;
translations.grk: Ἐπικατάρατος σὺ ἐν τῷ εἰσπορεύεσθαί σε, καὶ ἐπικατάρατος σὺ ἐν τῷ ἐκπορεύεσθαί σε.

verses.geez:
ወይፌኑ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ንዴተ ፡ ወረኃበ ፡ ወብድብደ ፡ ወይጠፍእ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘወደይከ ፡ እዴከ ፡ ውስቴቱ ፡
                  ወይሤርወከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይደመስሰከ ፡ ፍጡነ ፡ በበይነ ፡ እከየ ፡ ምግባሪከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀደገኒ ።
verses.translation: The Lord send upon thee want, and famine, and consumption on all things on which thou shalt put thy hand, until he shall have utterly destroyed thee, and until he shall have consumed thee quickly because of thine evil devices, because thou hast forsaken me.

translations.lxx: The Lord send upon thee want, and famine, and consumption on all things on which thou shalt put thy hand, until he shall have utterly destroyed thee, and until he shall have consumed thee quickly because of thine evil devices, because thou hast forsaken me.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
translations.ron: Să trimită Domnul asupra ta blestem, tulburare şi necaz în tot lucrul mâinilor tale pe care te vei apuca să-l faci, până vei fi stârpit şi până vei pieri curând, pentru faptele tale rele şi pentru că M-ai părăsit;
translations.grk: Ἀποστείλαι Κύριος ἐπὶ σὲ τὴν ἔνδειαν καὶ τὴν ἐκλιμίαν καὶ τὴν ἀνάλωσιν ἐπὶ πάντα οὗ ἐὰν ἐπιβάλῃς τὴν χεῖρά σου, ἕως ἂν ἐξολοθρεύσῃ σε, καὶ ἕως ἂν ἀπολέσῃ σε ἐν τάχει διὰ τὰ πονηρὰ ἐπιτηδεύματά σου, διότι ἐνκατέλιπές με.

verses.geez:
ወያተሉ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሞተ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ያጠፍአከ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ትበውእ ፡ ህየ ፡
                  ከመ ፡ ትትወረሳ ።
verses.translation: The Lord cause the pestilence to cleave to thee, until he shall have consumed thee off the land into which thou goest to inherit it.

translations.lxx: The Lord cause the pestilence to cleave to thee, until he shall have consumed thee off the land into which thou goest to inherit it.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
translations.ron: Ba să mai trimită Domnul asupra ta ciumă, până te va stârpi de pe pământul în care mergi ca să-l stăpâneşti;
translations.grk: Προσκολλήσαι Κύριος εἰς σὲ τὸν θάνατον, ἕως ἂν ἐξαναλώσῃ σε ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς, εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύῃ ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν.

verses.geez:
ወይቀሥፈከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በደዌ ፡ ሲሕ ፡ ወበፈጸንት ፡ ወበአስፈር ፡ ወበፍርሃት ፡ ወበድንጋፄ ፡ ወበዐባር ፡ ወበኀጣእ
                  ፡ ወይሰድዱከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ያጠፍኡከ ።
verses.translation: The Lord smite thee with distress, and fever, and cold, and inflammation, and blighting, and paleness, and they shall pursue thee until they have destroyed thee.

translations.lxx: The Lord smite thee with distress, and fever, and cold, and inflammation, and blighting, and paleness, and they shall pursue thee until they have destroyed thee.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
translations.ron: Să te bată Domnul cu oftică, cu lingoare, cu friguri, cu aprindere, cu secetă, cu vânt rău şi cu rugină, şi te vor urmări acestea până vei pieri;
translations.grk: Πατάξαι σε Κύριος ἐν ἀπορίᾳ, καὶ πυρετῷ, καὶ ῥίγει, καὶ ἐρεθισμῷ, καὶ ἀνεμοφθορίᾳ, καὶ τῇ ὤχρᾳ, καὶ καταδιώξονταί σε ἕως ἂν ἀπολέσωσί σε.

verses.geez: ወትከውነከ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ በመልዕልተ ፡ ርእስከ ፡ ብርተ ፡ ወምድርኒ ፡ በመትሕቴከ ፡ ሐፂነ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt have over thine head a sky of brass, and the earth under thee shall be iron.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt have over thine head a sky of brass, and the earth under thee shall be iron.
translations.kjv: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.
translations.ron: Cerurile tale, care sunt deasupra capului tău, să se facă aramă şi pământul de sub tine fier;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται σοι ὁ οὐρανὸς ὁ ὑπὲρ κεφαλῆς σου χαλκοῦς, καὶ ἡ γῆ ἡ ὑποκάτω σου σιδηρᾶ.

verses.geez:
ወይሬስዮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለዝናመ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ ቆባረ ፡ ወመሬት ፡ ይወርድ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይቀጠቅጠከ
                  ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ያጠፍአከ ።
verses.translation: The Lord thy God make the rain of thy land dust; and dust shall come down from heaven, until it shall have destroyed thee, and until it shall have quickly consumed thee.

translations.lxx: The Lord thy God make the rain of thy land dust; and dust shall come down from heaven, until it shall have destroyed thee, and until it shall have quickly consumed thee.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
translations.ron: În loc de ploaie, Domnul să dea pământului tău praf şi pulbere, care să cadă din cer asupra ta până te va pierde şi până vei fi prăpădit;
translations.grk: Δῴη Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου τὸν ὑετὸν τῇς γῇς σου κονιορτὸν, καὶ χοῦς ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβήσεται, ἕως ἂν ἐκτρίψῃ σε, καὶ ἕως ἂν ἀπολέσῃ σε ἐν τάχει.

verses.geez:
ወይገብረከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ትትቀተል ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ፀርከ ፡ በአሐቲ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ ትወፅእ ፡ ኀቤሆሙ ፡ ወበሰብዑ ፡
                  ፍናዌ ፡ ትነትዕ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጾሙ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ ዝርወ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ መንግሥታተ ፡ ምድር ።
verses.translation: The Lord give thee up for slaughter before thine enemies: thou shalt go out against them one way, and flee from their face seven ways; and thou shalt be a dispersion in all the kingdoms of the earth.

translations.lxx: The Lord give thee up for slaughter before thine enemies: thou shalt go out against them one way, and flee from their face seven ways; and thou shalt be a dispersion in all the kingdoms of the earth.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
translations.ron: Domnul te va da să fii bătut de vrăjmaşii tăi; pe un drum să mergi asupra lor şi pe şapte drumuri să fugi de ei şi să fii împrăştiat prin toate ţările pământului;
translations.grk: Δῴη σε Κύριος ἐπὶ κοπὴν ἐναντίον τῶν ἐχθρῶν· ἐν ὁδῷ μιᾷ ἐξελεύσῃ πρὸς αὐτοὺς, καὶ ἐν ἑπτὰ ὁδοῖς φεύξῃ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν· καὶ ἔσῃ διασπορὰ ἐν πάσαις βασιλείαις τῆς γῆς.

verses.geez: ወይከውን ፡ አብድንቲክሙ ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ለአዕዋፈ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወኢትረክቡ ፡ ዘይቀብረክሙ ።
verses.translation: And your dead men shall be food to the birds of the sky, and to the beasts of the earth; and there shall be none to scare them away.

translations.lxx: And your dead men shall be food to the birds of the sky, and to the beasts of the earth; and there shall be none to scare them away.
translations.kjv: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
translations.ron: Trupurile tale să fie hrană tuturor păsărilor cerului şi fiarelor şi nu va fi cine să le alunge;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσονται οἱ νεκροὶ ὑμῶν κατάβρωμα τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς, καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ ἐκφοβῶν.

verses.geez:
ወይቀሥፈከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በመቅሠፍተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ በዐበቅ ፡ እኩይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ነፍስትከ ፡ ወበሕከክ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ፈውሰ
                  ።
verses.translation: The Lord smite thee with the botch of Egypt in the seat, and with a malignant scab, and itch, so that thou canst not be healed.

translations.lxx: The Lord smite thee with the botch of Egypt in the seat, and with a malignant scab, and itch, so that thou canst not be healed.
translations.kjv: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
translations.ron: Te va lovi Domnul cu lepra Egiptului, cu trânji, cu râie şi cu pecingine, de care să nu te poţi vindeca;
translations.grk: Πατάξαι σε Κύριος ἕλκει Αἰγυπτίῳ εἰς τὴν ἕδραν, καὶ ψώρᾳ ἀγρίᾳ, καὶ κνήφῃ, ὥστε μὴ δύνασθαί σε ἰαθῆναι.

verses.geez: ወይቀሥፈከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በድቀት ፡ ወበዕወር ፡ ወበድንጋፄ ፡ ልብ ።
verses.translation: The Lord smite thee with insanity, and blindness, and astonishment of mind.

translations.lxx: The Lord smite thee with insanity, and blindness, and astonishment of mind.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
translations.ron: Să te bată Domnul cu nebunie, cu orbire şi cu amorţirea inimii;
translations.grk: Πατάξαι σε Κύριος παραπληξίᾳ, καὶ ἀορασίᾳ, καὶ ἐκστάσει διανοίας.

verses.geez:
ወትገብእ ፡ ትመረስስ ፡ መዐልተ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይመረስስ ፡ ዕውር ፡ በውስተ ፡ ጽልመት ፡ ወኢትረክብ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ወትትገፋዕ ፡
                  ወትትበረበር ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕሊከ ፡ ወኢትረክብ ፡ ዘይረድአከ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt grope at mid-day, as a blind man would grope in the darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways; and then thou shalt be unjustly treated, and plundered continually, and there shall be no helper.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt grope at mid-day, as a blind man would grope in the darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways; and then thou shalt be unjustly treated, and plundered continually, and there shall be no helper.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.
translations.ron: Pe dibuite să mergi ziua în amiaza mare, cum umblă orbul pipăind pe întuneric, şi să te strâmtoreze şi să te ocărască în toate zilele, şi nimeni să nu te apere;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσῃ ψηλαφῶν μεσημβρίας, ὡσεί τις ψηλαφήσαι τυφλὸς ἐν τῷ σκότει, καὶ οὐκ εὐοδώσει τὰς ὁδούς σου· καὶ ἔσῃ τότε ἀδικούμενος, καὶ διαρπαζόμενος πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας, καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ βοηθῶν.

verses.geez:
ወታወስብ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ወየሀይደካሃ ፡ ካልእ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ወትነድቅ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ወኢትነብር ፡ ውስቴቱ ፡ ወትተክል ፡ ወይነ ፡
                  ወኢትቀሥሞ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt take a wife, and another man shall have her; thou shalt build a house, and thou shalt not dwell in it; thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes of it.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt take a wife, and another man shall have her; thou shalt build a house, and thou shalt not dwell in it; thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes of it.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
translations.ron: Cu femeie să te logodeşti şi altul să se culce cu ea; casă să zideşti, şi să nu trăieşti în ea; vie să sădeşti, dar de ea să nu te foloseşti;
translations.grk: Γυναῖκα λήψῃ, καὶ ἀνὴρ ἕτερος ἕξει αὐτήν· οἰκίαν οἰκοδομήσεις, καὶ οὐκ οἰκήσεις ἐν αὐτῇ· ἀμπελῶνα φυτεύσεις, καὶ οὐ μὴ τρυγήσεις αὐτόν.

verses.geez:
ወይጠብኁ ፡ ላህመከ ፡ ወኢትበልዕ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ወየሀይዱከ ፡ አድገከ ፡ ወኢያገብኡ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወይገብእ ፡ አባግዒከ ፡
                  (ለአግብርት ፡ ወ)ለፀርከ ፡ ወኢትረክብ ፡ ዘይረድእከ ።
verses.translation: Thy calf shall be slain before thee, and thou shalt not eat of it; thine ass shall be violently taken away from thee, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given to thine enemies, and thou shalt have no helper.

translations.lxx: Thy calf shall be slain before thee, and thou shalt not eat of it; thine ass shall be violently taken away from thee, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given to thine enemies, and thou shalt have no helper.
translations.kjv: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them.
translations.ron: Boul tău să fie junghiat sub ochii tăi şi să nu-l mănânci tu; asinul să ţi-l ia şi să nu ţi-l mai aducă; oile tale să fie date vrăjmaşilor tăi şi nimeni să nu te izbăvească;
translations.grk: Ὁ μόσχος σου ἐσφαγμένος ἐναντίον σου, καὶ οὐ φάγῃ ἐξ αὐτοῦ· ὁ ὄνος σου ἡρπασμένος ἀπὸ σοῦ, καὶ οὐκ ἀποδοθήσεταί σοι· τὰ πρόβατά σου δεδομένα τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου,

verses.geez:
ወይገብኡ ፡ ደቂቅከ ፡ ወአዋልዲከ ፡ ለካልእ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወትሬኢ ፡ በአዕይንቲከ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይኰርዕዎሙ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡
                  ዘትክል ፡ ገቢረ ።
verses.translation: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given to another nation, and thine eyes wasting away shall look for them: thine hand shall have no strength.

translations.lxx: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given to another nation, and thine eyes wasting away shall look for them: thine hand shall have no strength.
translations.kjv: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand:
translations.ron: Fiii tăi şi fiicele tale să fie date la popor străin; ochii tăi să-i vadă şi să se topească în toate zilele de mila lor, dar să nu ai nici o putere în mâinile tale;
translations.grk: καὶ οὐκ ἔσται σοι ὁ βοηθῶν. Οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες σου δεδομέναι ἔθνει ἑτέρῳ, καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου βλέψονται σφακελίζοντες εἰς αὐτὰ· οὐκ ἰσχύσει ἡ χείρ σου.

verses.geez: ወይበልዕ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዘኢታአምር ፡ እክለ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ ወጻማከ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ ጽዑረ ፡ ወሥቁየ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕል ።
verses.translation: A nation which thou knowest not shall eat the produce of thy land, and all thy labours; and thou shalt be injured and crushed always.

translations.lxx: A nation which thou knowest not shall eat the produce of thy land, and all thy labours; and thou shalt be injured and crushed always.
translations.kjv: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:
translations.ron: Roadele pământului tău şi toate ostenelile tale să le mănânce un popor pe care tu nu l-ai cunoscut, iar tu să fii numai strâmtorat şi chinuit în toate zilele;
translations.grk: Τὰ ἐκφόρια τῆς γῆς σου, καὶ πάντας τοὺς πόνους σου φάγεται ἔθνος, ὃ οὐκ ἐπίστασαι· καὶ ἔσῃ ἀδικούμενος καὶ τεθραυσμένος πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας.

verses.geez: ወትከውን ፡ ምሑፀ ፡ በምርኣየ ፡ አዕይንቲከ ፡ ወኢትሬኢ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt be distracted, because of the sights of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt be distracted, because of the sights of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
translations.kjv: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
translations.ron: Din pricina celor ce-ţi vor vedea ochii tăi, îţi vei ieşi din minţi;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσῃ παράπληκτος διὰ τὰ ὁράματα τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου, ἃ βλέψῃ.

verses.geez:
ወይቀሥፈከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በደዌ ፡ እኩይ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብረኪከ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ አቍያጺከ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ አዕማደ ፡ እገሪከ ፡
                  በዘ ፡ ኢትክል ፡ ሐይወ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሰኰና ፡ እገሪከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ርእስከ ።
verses.translation: The Lord smite thee with an evil sore, on the knees and the legs, so that thou shalt not be able to be healed from the sole of thy foot to the crown of thy head.

translations.lxx: The Lord smite thee with an evil sore, on the knees and the legs, so that thou shalt not be able to be healed from the sole of thy foot to the crown of thy head.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
translations.ron: Domnul te va lovi cu lepră rea peste genunchi şi peste fluiere şi din tălpile picioarelor tale până în creştetul capului tău, de care nu te vei mai putea vindeca;
translations.grk: Πατάξαι σε Κύριος ἐν ἕλκει πονηρῷ ἐπὶ τὰ γόνατα καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς κνήμας, ὥστε μὴ δύνασθαι ἰαθῆναί σε ἀπὸ ἴχνους τῶν ποδῶν σου ἕως τῆς κορυφῆς σου.

verses.geez:
ወይወስደከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ኪያከኒ ፡ ወመላእክቲከኒ ፡ እለ ፡ ሤምከ ፡ ለከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ (ዐቢይ ፡) ዘኢታአምር
                  ፡ ኢአንተ ፡ ወኢአበዊከ ፡ ወታመልክ ፡ በህየ ፡ ባዕደ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ ወዕፀወ ፡ ወእበነ ።
verses.translation: The Lord carry away thee and thy princes, whom thou shalt set over thee, to a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers know; and thou shalt there serve other gods, wood and stone.

translations.lxx: The Lord carry away thee and thy princes, whom thou shalt set over thee, to a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers know; and thou shalt there serve other gods, wood and stone.
translations.kjv: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
translations.ron: Te va duce Domnul pe tine şi pe regele tău, pe care-l vei pune peste tine, la poporul pe care nu l-ai cunoscut nici tu, nici părinţii tăi, şi acolo vei sluji altor dumnezei de lemn şi de piatră;
translations.grk: Ἀπαγάγοι Κύριός σε καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντάς σου, οὓς ἂν καταστήσῃς ἐπὶ σεαυτὸν, ἐπʼ ἔθνος ὃ οὐκ ἐπίστασαι σὺ καὶ οἱ πατέρες σου, καὶ λατρεύσεις ἐκεῖ θεοῖς ἑτέροις ξύλοις καὶ λίθοις.

verses.geez:
ወትከውን ፡ በህየ ፡ ድንጉፀ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ አምሳለ ፡ ወነገረ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እለ ፡ ውስቴቶሙ ፡ (ወእለ ፡
                  ኀቤሆሙ ፡) ይወስደከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ህየ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt be there for a wonder, and a parable, and a tale, among all the nations, to which the Lord thy God shall carry thee away.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt be there for a wonder, and a parable, and a tale, among all the nations, to which the Lord thy God shall carry thee away.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
translations.ron: Şi vei fi de spaimă, de pomină şi de râs la toate popoarele la care te va duce Domnul Dumnezeul tău;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσῃ ἐκεῖ ἐν αἰνίγματι καὶ παραβολῇ καὶ διηγήματι ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, εἰς οὓς ἂν ἀπαγάγῃ σε Κύριος ἐκεῖ.

verses.geez: ወታወጽእ ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ ዘርዐ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገራህትከ ፡ ወታበውእ ፡ ውሑደ ፡ እስመ ፡ አንበጣ ፡ በልዖ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt carry forth much seed into the field, and thou shalt bring in little, because the locust shall devour it.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt carry forth much seed into the field, and thou shalt bring in little, because the locust shall devour it.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.
translations.ron: Vei semăna multă sămânţă în ţarină, dar puţină vei culege, pentru că o vor mânca lăcustele;
translations.grk: Σπέρμα πολὺ ἐξοίσεις εἰς τὸ πεδίον, καὶ ὀλίγα εἰσοίσεις, ὅτι κατέδεται αὐτὰ ἡ ἀκρίς·

verses.geez:
ወትተክል ፡ ዐጸደ ፡ ወይን ፡ ወትትጌበሮ ፡ ወኢትሰቲ ፡ እምነ ፡ ወይኑ ፡ ወኢትትፌሣሕ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዕፄ ፡
                  በልዖ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt plant a vineyard, and dress it, and shalt not drink the wine, neither shalt thou delight thyself with it, because the worm shall devour it.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt plant a vineyard, and dress it, and shalt not drink the wine, neither shalt thou delight thyself with it, because the worm shall devour it.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.
translations.ron: Vii vei sădi şi le vei lucra, dar nu le vei culege, nici nu vei bea vin, pentru că le vor mânca viermii;
translations.grk: Ἀμπελῶνα φυτεύσεις καὶ κατεργᾷ, καὶ οἶνον οὐ πίεσαι οὐδὲ εὐφρανθήσῃ ἐξ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι καταφάγεται αὐτὰ ὁ σκώληξ.

verses.geez: ወታጠሪ ፡ ዕፀዋተ ፡ ዘይት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ደወልከ ፡ ወኢትትቀባእ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተነግፈ ፡ ፍሬሁ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt have olive trees in all thy borders, and thou shalt not anoint thee with oil, because thine olive shall utterly cast its fruit.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt have olive trees in all thy borders, and thou shalt not anoint thee with oil, because thine olive shall utterly cast its fruit.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit.
translations.ron: Măslini încă vei avea în toate ţinuturile tale, dar cu untdelemn nu te vei unge, pentru că măslinele tale vor cădea;
translations.grk: Ἐλαῖαι ἔσονταί σοι ἐν πᾶσι τοὶς ὁρίοις σου, καὶ ἔλαιον οὐ χρίσῃ, ὅτι ἐκρυήσεται ἡ ἐλαία σου.

verses.geez: ወትወልድ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ወአዋልደ ፡ ወኢያተርፍዎሙ ፡ ለከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ይነሥእዎሙ ፡ ወይፄውዎሙ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, and they shall not be thine, for they shall depart into captivity.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, and they shall not be thine, for they shall depart into captivity.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
translations.ron: Fii şi fiice vei naşte, dar nu-i vei avea, pentru că vor fi luaţi în robie;
translations.grk: Υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας γεννήσεις καὶ οὐκ ἔσονται· ἀπελεύσονται γὰρ ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ.

verses.geez: ወኵሎ ፡ እክለ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ተክለ ፡ ዕፀዋቲከ ፡ አናኵዕ ፡ ያጠፍኦ ፡ ለከ ።
verses.translation: All thy trees and the fruits of thy land shall the blight consume.

translations.lxx: All thy trees and the fruits of thy land shall the blight consume.
translations.kjv: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
translations.ron: Toţi pomii tăi şi roadele pământului le va strica rugina;
translations.grk: Πάντα τὰ ξύλινά σου, καὶ τὰ γεννήματα τῆς γῆς σου ἐξαναλώσει ἡ ἐρισύβη.

verses.geez: ወፈላሲ ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ የዐርግ ፡ መልዕልቴከ ፡ ወላዕሌከ ፡ ወአንተሰ ፡ ትከውን ፡ መትሕቶ ።
verses.translation: The stranger that is within thee shall get up very high, and thou shalt come down very low.

translations.lxx: The stranger that is within thee shall get up very high, and thou shalt come down very low.
translations.kjv: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
translations.ron: Străinul cel din mijlocul tău se va înălţa peste tine din ce în ce mai sus, iar tu te vei pogorî din ce în ce mai jos;
translations.grk: Ὁ προσήλυτος ὅς ἐστιν ἐν σοὶ, ἀναβήσεται ἄνω ἄνω, σὺ δὲ καταβήσῃ κάτω κάτω.

verses.geez: ወውእቱ ፡ ይሌቅሐከ ፡ ወአንተሰ ፡ ኢትሌቅሖ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይከውነከ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ወአንተ ፡ ትከውኖ ፡ ዘነበ ።
verses.translation: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.

translations.lxx: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
translations.kjv: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
translations.ron: Acela îţi va da împrumut, iar tu nu-i vei da lui împrumut; acela va fi cap, iar tu vei fi coadă.
translations.grk: Οὗτος δανειεῖ σοι, σὺ δὲ τούτῳ οὐ δανειεῖς· οὗτος ἔσται κεφαλὴ, σὺ δὲ ἔσῃ οὐρά.

verses.geez:
ወይመጽእ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ መርገም ፡ ወይዴግነከ ፡ ወይረክበከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ያጠፍአከ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ይደመስሰከ
                  ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢሰማዕከ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትዕቀብ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ወኵነኔሁ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአዘዘከ ።
verses.translation: And all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and shall overtake thee, until he shall have consumed thee, and until he shall have destroyed thee; because thou didst not hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commands, and his ordinances which he has commanded thee.

translations.lxx: And all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and shall overtake thee, until he shall have consumed thee, and until he shall have destroyed thee; because thou didst not hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commands, and his ordinances which he has commanded thee.
translations.kjv: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
translations.ron: Vor veni asupra ta toate blestemele acestea, te vor urmări şi te vor ajunge. până vei fi stârpit, pentru că n-ai ascultat glasul Domnului Dumnezeului tău şi n-ai păzit poruncile Lui, nici hotărârile Lui pe care ţi le-a dat El.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ σὲ πᾶσαι αἱ κατάραι αὗται, καὶ καταδιώξονταί σε, καὶ καταλήψονταί σε, ἔως ἂν ἐξολοθρεύσῃ σε, καὶ ἕως ἂν ἀπολέσῃ σε· ὅτι οὐκ εἰσήκουσας τῆς φωνῆς Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου, φυλάξαι τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα ὅσα ἐνετείλατό σοι.

verses.geez: ወይከውን ፡ ተአምር ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ ወመድምም ፡ ወላዕለ ፡ ዘርእከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.translation: And these things shall be signs in thee, and wonders among thy seed for ever;

translations.lxx: And these things shall be signs in thee, and wonders among thy seed for ever;
translations.kjv: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
translations.ron: Şi vor fi ele semn şi pecete asupra ta şi asupra seminţiei tale în veci.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ἐν σοὶ σημεῖα, καὶ τέρατα ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος,

verses.geez: እስመ ፡ ኢያምለካሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ በትፍሥሕት ፡ ወበሠናይ ፡ ልብ ፡ ወበብዝኀ ፡ ኵሉ ።
verses.translation: because thou didst not serve the Lord thy God with gladness and a good heart, because of the abundance of all things.

translations.lxx: because thou didst not serve the Lord thy God with gladness and a good heart, because of the abundance of all things.
translations.kjv: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
translations.ron: Pentru că tu n-ai slujit Domnului Dumnezeului tău cu veselia şi cu bucuria inimii, când erai îmbelşugat de toate.
translations.grk: ἀνθʼ ὧν οὐκ ἐλάτρευσας Κυρίῳ τῷ Θεῷ σου ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ καὶ ἀγαθῇ διανοίᾳ διὰ τὸ πλῆθος πάντων.

verses.geez:
ወትትቀነይ ፡ ለጸላእትከ ፡ እለ ፡ ይፌኑ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ በረኃብ ፡ ወበጽምእ ፡ ወበዕርቅና ፡ ወበኀጣአ ፡
                  ኵሉ ፡ ወይወዲ ፡ ለከ ፡ ጋጋ ፡ ዘኀፂን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ክሳድከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ያጠፍአከ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt serve thine enemies, which the Lord will send forth against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in the want of all things; and thou shalt wear upon thy neck a yoke of iron until he shall have destroyed thee.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt serve thine enemies, which the Lord will send forth against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in the want of all things; and thou shalt wear upon thy neck a yoke of iron until he shall have destroyed thee.
translations.kjv: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
translations.ron: Vei sluji vrăjmaşului tău, pe care-l va trimite asupra ta Domnul Dumnezeul tău, când vei fi în foamete şi în sete şi în golătate şi în tot felul de lipsă; acela va pune pe grumazul tău jug de fier şi te va istovi.
translations.grk: Καὶ λατρεύσεις τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου, οὓς ἐπαποστελεῖ Κύριος ἐπὶ σέ, ἐν λιμῷ, καὶ ἐν δίψει, καὶ ἐν γυμνότητι, καὶ ἐν ἐκλείψει πάντων· καὶ ἐπιθήσῃ κλοιὸν σιδηροῦν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλόν σου, ἕως ἂν ἐξολοθρεύσῃ σε.

verses.geez:
ወያመጽእ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ እምርሑቅ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ እምአጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ፡ ከመ ፡ ርደተ ፡ ንስር ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እለ
                  ፡ ኢትሰምዕ ፡ ነገሮሙ ፤
verses.translation: The Lord shall bring upon thee a nation from the extremity of the earth, like the swift flying of an eagle, a nation whose voice thou shalt not understand;

translations.lxx: The Lord shall bring upon thee a nation from the extremity of the earth, like the swift flying of an eagle, a nation whose voice thou shalt not understand;
translations.kjv: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
translations.ron: Trimite-va Domnul asupra ta popor din depărtare, de la marginea pământului; ca un vultur va veni poporul acela a cărui limbă tu nu o vei înţelege;
translations.grk: Ἐπάξει ἐπὶ σὲ Κύριος ἔθνος μακρόθεν ἀπʼ ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς ὡσεὶ ὅρμημα ἀετοῦ, ἔθνος ὃ οὐκ ἀκούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ,

verses.geez: ሕዝብ ፡ ግሩመ ፡ ገጽ ፡ ዘኢያከብር ፡ ገጸ ፡ ልሂቅ ፡ ወኢይምሕር ፡ ንዑሰ ፤
verses.translation: a nation bold in countenance, which shall not respect the person of the aged and shall not pity the young.

translations.lxx: a nation bold in countenance, which shall not respect the person of the aged and shall not pity the young.
translations.kjv: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
translations.ron: Popor crunt, care nu va da cinste bătrânului şi nu va cruţa pe cel tânăr.
translations.grk: ἔθνος ἀναιδὲς προσώπῳ, ὅστις οὐ θαυμάσει πρόσωπον πρεσβύτου, καὶ νέον οὐκ ἐλεήσει.

verses.geez:
ወያጠፍእ ፡ እጕለ ፡ መራዕይከ ፡ ወእክለ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ኢያተርፍ ፡ ለከ ፡ ኢእክለ ፡ ወኢወይነ ፡ ወኢቅብአ ፡
                  ወኢአዕጻዳተ ፡ ላህምከ ፡ ወኢመራዕየ ፡ አባግዒከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ያጠፍአከ ።
verses.translation: And it shall eat up the young of thy cattle, and the fruits of thy land, so as not to leave to thee corn, wine, oil, the herds of thine oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep, until it shall have destroyed thee;

translations.lxx: And it shall eat up the young of thy cattle, and the fruits of thy land, so as not to leave to thee corn, wine, oil, the herds of thine oxen, and the flocks of thy sheep, until it shall have destroyed thee;
translations.kjv: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
translations.ron: Va mânca acela rodul dobitoacelor tale şi rodul pământului tău, până te va nimici, căci nu-ţi va lăsa nici pâine, nici vin, nici untdelemn, nici rodul vitelor tale, nici rodul oilor tale, până te va pierde.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέδεται τὰ ἔγκονα τῶν κτηνῶν σου, καὶ τὰ γεννήματα τῆς γῆς σου, ὥστε μὴ καταλιπεῖν σοι σῖτον, οἶνον, ἔλαιον, τὰ βουκόλια τῶν βοῶν σου, καὶ τὰ ποίμνια τῶν προβάτων σου, ἕως ἂν ἀπολέσῃ σε.

verses.geez:
ወይደመስሰከ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አህጉሪከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ያወድቅ ፡ አረፋቲከ ፡ ዐበይተ ፡ ወአጽዋኒከ ፡ ዘቦቱ ፡ ትትአመን
                  ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ በሓውርቲከ ፡ ወይሣቅየከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አህጉሪከ ፡ ዘወሀበከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
verses.translation: and have utterly crushed thee in thy cities, until the high and strong walls be destroyed, in which thou trustest, in all thy land; and it shall afflict thee in thy cities, which he has given to thee.

translations.lxx: and have utterly crushed thee in thy cities, until the high and strong walls be destroyed, in which thou trustest, in all thy land; and it shall afflict thee in thy cities, which he has given to thee.
translations.kjv: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
translations.ron: Te va strâmtora în toate cetăţile tale, până ce va dărâma, în tot pământul tău, zidurile tale cele înalte şi tari în care nădăjduieşti tu şi te va împila în toate locaşurile tale, în tot pământul tău pe care Domnul Dumnezeul tău ţi-l dă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκτρίψῃ σε ἐν ταῖς πόλεσί σου, ἕως ἂν καθαιρεθῶσι τὰ τείχη τὰ ὑψηλὰ καὶ τὰ ὀχυρὰ, ἐφʼ οἷς σὺ πέποιθας ἐπʼ αὐτοῖς, ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ σου· καὶ θλίψει σε ἐν ταῖς πόλεσί σου, αἷς ἔδωκέ σοι.

verses.geez:
ወ[ትበልዕ]፡ ውሉደ ፡ ከርሥከ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ደቂቅከ ፡ ወአዋልዲከ ፡ ዘወሀበከ ፡ በምንዳቤከ ፡ ወበሥቃይከ ፡ ዘሣቀየከ ፡
                  ጸላኢከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አህጉሪከ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thy body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, all that he has given thee, in thy straitness and thy affliction, with which thine enemy shall afflict thee.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thy body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, all that he has given thee, in thy straitness and thy affliction, with which thine enemy shall afflict thee.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
translations.ron: Şi vei mânca tu rodul pântecelui tău, carnea fiilor şi fiicelor tale, pe care ţi-i va fi dat Domnul Dumnezeul tău în timpul împresurării şi al strâmtorării cu care te va strâmtora vrăjmaşul tău.
translations.grk: Καὶ φαγῇ τὰ ἔκγονα τῆς κοιλίας σου, κρέα υἱῶν σου καὶ θυγατέρων σου, ὅσα ἔδωκέ σοι, ἐν τῇ στενοχωρίᾳ σου καὶ ἐν τῇ θλίψει σου, ἡ· θλίψει σε ὁ ἐχθρός σου.

verses.geez:
ረኀጽከሂ ፡ ወለምለምከሂ ፡ ወትደነፁ ፡ ዐይኑ ፡ ለእኁሁ ፡ ወለብእሲቱ ፡ እንተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕፅኑ ፡ ወዘተርፈ ፡ ውሉድ ፡
                  ዘአትረፉ ፡ ሎሙ ።
verses.translation: He that is tender and very delicate within thee shall look with an evil eye upon his brother, and the wife in his bosom, and the children that are left, which may have been left to him;

translations.lxx: He that is tender and very delicate within thee shall look with an evil eye upon his brother, and the wife in his bosom, and the children that are left, which may have been left to him;
translations.kjv: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
translations.ron: Bărbatul tău, cel răsfăţat şi trăit în alintare, va privi cu ochi nemilostivi la fratele său; la soţia de la sânul său şi la ceilalţi copii ai săi, care îţi vor rămâne.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἁπαλὸς ὁ ἐν σοὶ καὶ ὁ τρυφερὸς σφόδρα, βασκανεῖ τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα τὴν ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ καταλελειμμένα τέκνα, ἃ ἂν καταλειφθῇ

verses.geez:
ይሁብዎሙ ፡ ለለ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ውሉዶሙ ፡ ይሴሰዩ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢያትረፉ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ወኢምንተ ፡ በሥቃይ ፡
                  ወበምንዳቤ ፡ ዘይሣቅዩከ ፡ ጸላእትከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ አህጉሪከ ።
verses.translation: so as not to give to one of them of the flesh of his children, whom he shall eat, because of his having nothing left him in thy straitness, and in thy affliction, with which thine enemies shall afflict thee in all thy cities.

translations.lxx: so as not to give to one of them of the flesh of his children, whom he shall eat, because of his having nothing left him in thy straitness, and in thy affliction, with which thine enemies shall afflict thee in all thy cities.
translations.kjv: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
translations.ron: Şi nu va da nici unuia din ei carne din copiii săi, pe care îi va mânca el, căci nu-i va mai rămâne nimic în vremea împresurării cu care te va strâmtora vrăjmaşul tău în toate cetăţile tale.
translations.grk: αὐτῷ, ὥστε δοῦναι ἑνὶ αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῶν σαρκῶν τῶν τέκνων αὐτοῦ, ὧν ἂν κατέσθῃ διὰ τὸ μὴ καταλειφθῆναι αὐτῷ οὐδὲν ἐν τῇ στενοχωρίᾳ σου, καὶ ἐν τῇ θλίψει σου, ἡ· ἂν θλίψωσί σε οἱ ἐχθροί σου ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσί σου.

verses.geez:
ወእንተ ፡ ረኃጽኒ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ እምኔክሙ ፡ ወእንተሂ ፡ ድክምት ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ትሜህር ፡ እገሪሃ ፡ ሐዊረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር
                  ፡ ወእስመ ፡ ረኃፅ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወድክምት ፡ ትደነጽዎ ፡ ዐይና ፡ ለምታ ፡ ዘዲበ ፡ ሕፅና ፡ ወለወልዳ ፡ ወለወለታ ።
verses.translation: And she that is tender and delicate among you, whose foot has not assayed to go upon the earth for delicacy and tenderness, shall look with an evil eye on her husband in her bosom, and her son and her daughter,

translations.lxx: And she that is tender and delicate among you, whose foot has not assayed to go upon the earth for delicacy and tenderness, shall look with an evil eye on her husband in her bosom, and her son and her daughter,
translations.kjv: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
translations.ron: Femeia ta, trăită în belşug şi răsfăţ, care nu şi-a pus piciorul său în pământ din pricina traiului alintat şi îndestulat dinainte, va privi cu ochi nemilostivi pe bărbatul de la sânul ei şi la fiul său şi la fiica sa,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡ ἁπαλὴ ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ ἡ τρυφερά, ἧς οὐχὶ πεῖραν ἔλαβεν ὁ ποὺς αὐτῆς βαίνειν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς διὰ τὴν τρυφερότητα καὶ διὰ τὴν ἁπαλότητα, βασκανεῖ τῷ ὀφθαλμῷ αὐτῆς τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς τὸν ἐν κόλπῳ αὐτῆς, καὶ τὸν υἱὸν καὶ τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτῆς,

verses.geez:
ወለሥጋሃ ፡ ዘእምውስተ ፡ አባላ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወሕፃናሂ ፡ ዘወለደት ፡ ትበልዕ ፡ ጽምሚተ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ኀጥአት ፡ ኵሎ ፡
                  በምንዳቤ ፡ ወበሥቃይ ፡ ዘይሣቅየከ ፡ ጸላኢከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አህጉሪከ ፤
verses.translation: and her offspring that comes out between her feet, and the child which she shall bear; for she shall eat them because of the want of all things, secretly in thy straitness, and in thy affliction, with which thine enemy shall afflict thee in thy cities.

translations.lxx: and her offspring that comes out between her feet, and the child which she shall bear; for she shall eat them because of the want of all things, secretly in thy straitness, and in thy affliction, with which thine enemy shall afflict thee in thy cities.
translations.kjv: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
translations.ron: Şi nu le va da fătul, care a ieşit din coapsele sale şi copiii, pe care i-a născut, pentru că ea, din pricina lipsei de toate, îi va mânca pe ascuns în timpul împresurării şi al strâmtorării cu care te va strâmtora vrăjmaşul tău în cetăţile tale.
translations.grk: καὶ τὸ κόριον αὐτῆς τὸ ἐξελθὸν διὰ τῶν μηρῶν αὐτῆς, καὶ τὸ τέκνον αὐτῆς ὃ ἐὰν τέκῃ· καταφάγεται γὰρ αὐτὰ διὰ τὴν ἔνδειαν πάντων κρυφῇ ἐν τῇ στενοχωρίᾳ σου, καὶ ἐν τῇ θλίψει σου, ἡ· θλίψει σε ὁ ἐχθρός σου ἐν ταῖς πόλεσί σου,

verses.geez:
ለእመ ፡ ኢሰማዕከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትግበር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ነገሮ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘጽሑፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ መጽሐፍ
                  ፡ ከመ ፡ ትፍራህ ፡ ስመ ፡ ክቡር ፡ ወስቡሕ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ዘእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
verses.translation: If thou wilt not hearken to do all the words of this law, which have been written in this book, to fear this glorious and wonderful name, the Lord thy God;

translations.lxx: If thou wilt not hearken to do all the words of this law, which have been written in this book, to fear this glorious and wonderful name, the Lord thy God;
translations.kjv: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;
translations.ron: De nu te vei sili să împlineşti toate cuvintele legii acesteia, care sunt scrise în cartea aceasta şi nu te vei teme de acest nume slăvit şi înfricoşător al Domnului Dumnezeului tău,
translations.grk: ἐὰν μὴ εἰσακούσῃς ποιεῖν πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ νόμου τούτου, τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τούτῳ, φοβεῖσθαι τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ἔντιμον τὸ θαυμαστὸν τοῦτο, ΚΥΡΙΟΝ τὸν ΘΕΟΝ σου.

verses.geez:
ወይገብር ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ነኪረ ፡ መቅሠፍተከ ፡ ወመቅሠፍተ ፡ ዘርእከ ፡ መቅሠፍተ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡ ወመድምመ ፡ ወደዌ ፡
                  እኩየ ፡ ወሕማመ ።
verses.translation: then the Lord shall magnify thy plagues, and the plagues of thy seed, great and wonderful plagues, and evil and abiding diseases.

translations.lxx: then the Lord shall magnify thy plagues, and the plagues of thy seed, great and wonderful plagues, and evil and abiding diseases.
translations.kjv: Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
translations.ron: Atunci Domnul te va bate pe tine şi pe urmaşii tăi cu plăgi nemaiauzite, cu plăgi mari şi nesfârşite şi cu boli rele şi necurmate;
translations.grk: Καὶ παραδοξάσει Κύριος τὰς πληγάς σου, καὶ τὰς πληγὰς τοῦ σπέρματός σου, πληγὰς μεγάλας καὶ θαυμαστὰς, καὶ νόσους πονηρὰς καὶ πιστάς.

verses.geez:
ወይገብእ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ደዌሆሙ ፡ ለግብጽ ፡ እኩይ ፡ ዝክቱ ፡ ዘኢፈራህከ ፡ (እምኔሁ ፡ ወኢፈራህከ ፡) እምቅድመ
                  ፡ ገጾሙ ፡ ወይተሉ ፡ ዲቤከ ።
verses.translation: And he shall bring upon thee all the evil pain of Egypt, of which thou wast afraid, and they shall cleave to thee.

translations.lxx: And he shall bring upon thee all the evil pain of Egypt, of which thou wast afraid, and they shall cleave to thee.
translations.kjv: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
translations.ron: Va aduce asupra ta toate plăgile cele rele ale Egiptului, de care te-ai temut şi se vor lipi acelea de tine.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιστρέψει πᾶσαν τὴν ὀδύνην Αἰγύπτου τὴν πονηρὰν, ἣν διευλαβοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν, καὶ κολληθήσονται ἐν σοί.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ ደዌ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ መቅሠፍት ፡ ዘኢኮነ ፡ ጽሑፈ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ መጽሐፈ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ያመጽእ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ላዕሌከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ያጠፍአከ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ትደመሰሱ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord shall bring upon thee every sickness, and every plague that is not written, and every one that is written in the book of this law, until he shall have destroyed thee.

translations.lxx: And the Lord shall bring upon thee every sickness, and every plague that is not written, and every one that is written in the book of this law, until he shall have destroyed thee.
translations.kjv: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
translations.ron: Toată boala, toată plaga scrisă şi toată cea nescrisă în cartea legii acesteia, o va aduce Domnul asupra ta, până vei fi stârpit.
translations.grk: Καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν, καὶ πᾶσαν πληγὴν τὴν μὴ γεγραμμένην, καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γεγραμμένην ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τοῦ νόμου τούτου, ἐπάξει Κύριος ἐπὶ σέ, ἕως ἂν ἐξολοθρεύσῃ σε.

verses.geez:
ወትተርፉ ፡ ኅዳጠ ፡ በኍልቍ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ከመ ፡ ከዋክብተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ብዝኅክሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢሰማዕክሙ ፡
                  ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ።
verses.translation: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of the sky in multitude; because thou didst not hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God.

translations.lxx: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of the sky in multitude; because thou didst not hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God.
translations.kjv: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.
translations.ron: Puţini din voi vor rămâne, deşi veţi fi fost ca stelele cerului, pentru că n-aţi ascultat glasul Domnului Dumnezeului vostru.
translations.grk: Καὶ καταλειφθήσεσθε ἐν ἀριθμῷ βραχεῖ, ἀνθʼ ὧν ὅτι ἦτε ὡσεὶ τὰ ἄστρα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῷ πλήθει, ὅτι οὐκ εἰσήκουσας τῆς φωνῆς Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου.

verses.geez:
ወበከመ ፡ ተፈሥሐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕሌክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበር ፡ ሠናይተ ፡ ዲቤክሙ ፡ ወአብዝኀክሙ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይትፌሣሕ
                  ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ዲቤክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሤርወክሙ ፡ ወትጠፍኡ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ትበውኡ ፡ ህየ ፡ ከመ ፡
                  ትትወረስዋ ።
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass that as the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you; and ye shall be quickly removed from the land, into which ye go to inherit it.

translations.lxx: And it shall come to pass that as the Lord rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so the Lord will rejoice over you to destroy you; and ye shall be quickly removed from the land, into which ye go to inherit it.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
translations.ron: Cum s-a bucurat Domnul, când v-a făcut bine şi v-a înmulţit, tot aşa se va bucura Domnul când vă va pierde şi vă va stârpi şi veţi fi aruncaţi din pământul în care intraţi ca să-l stăpâniţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ὃν τρόπον εὐφράνθη Κύριος ἐφʼ ὑμῖν εὖ ποιῆσαι ὑμᾶς, καὶ πληθῦναι ὑμᾶς, οὕτως εὐφρανθήσεται Κύριος ἐφʼ ὑμῖν ἐξολοθρεῦσαι ὑμᾶς· καὶ ἐξαρθήσεσθε ἐν τάχει ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς, εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύῃ ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτήν.

verses.geez:
ወይዘርወከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እምነ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ፡ እስከ ፡ አጽናፈ ፡ ምድር ፡
                  ወትትቀነይ ፡ በህየ ፡ ለባዕድ ፡ አማልክት ፡ ለእበን ፡ ወለዕፀው ፡ ለዘ ፡ ኢታአምር ፡ አንተ ፡ ወአበዊከ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord thy God shall scatter thee among all nations, from one end of the earth to the other; and thou shalt there serve other gods, wood and stone, which thou hast not known, nor thy fathers.

translations.lxx: And the Lord thy God shall scatter thee among all nations, from one end of the earth to the other; and thou shalt there serve other gods, wood and stone, which thou hast not known, nor thy fathers.
translations.kjv: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.
translations.ron: Atunci te va împrăştia Domnul Dumnezeul tău prin toate popoarele şi acolo vei sluji altor dumnezei, pe care nu i-ai cunoscut nici tu, nici părinţii tăi; vei sluji la lemne şi la pietre.
translations.grk: Καὶ διασπερεῖ σε Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, ἀπʼ ἄκρου τῆς γῆς ἕως ἄκρου τῆς γῆς, καὶ δουλεύσεις ἐκεῖ θεοῖς ἑτέροις, ξύλοις καὶ λίθοις, οὓς οὐκ ἠπίστω σὺ καὶ οἱ πατέρες σου.

verses.geez:
ወበህየኒ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ኢያዐርፈከ ፡ ወኢያበውሐከ ፡ ትቁም ፡ እግርከ ፡ ወይሁበከ ፡ በህየ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ልበ ፡ ሕዙነ ፡ ወአዕይንተ ፡ ጥፉኣተ ፡ ወነፍሰ ፡ ምንሱተ ።
verses.translation: Moreover among those nations he will not give thee quiet, neither by any means shall the sole of thy foot have rest; and the Lord shall give thee there another and a misgiving heart, and failing eyes, and a wasting soul.

translations.lxx: Moreover among those nations he will not give thee quiet, neither by any means shall the sole of thy foot have rest; and the Lord shall give thee there another and a misgiving heart, and failing eyes, and a wasting soul.
translations.kjv: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
translations.ron: Dar şi între aceste popoare nu te vei linişti şi nu vei avea loc de odihnă pentru piciorul tău, că Domnul îţi va da acolo inimă tremurătoare, topirea ochilor şi durere sufletului.
translations.grk: Ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐκείνοις οὐκ ἀναπαύσει σε, οὐδʼ οὐ μὴ γένηται στάσις τῷ ἴχνει τοῦ ποδός σου· καὶ δώσει σοι Κύριος ἐκεῖ καρδίαν ἑτέραν ἀπειθοῦσαν, καὶ ἐκλείποντας ὀφθαλμοὺς, καὶ τηκομένην ψυχήν.

verses.geez:
ወትከውን ፡ ሕይወትከ ፡ ስቅልተ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ አዕይንቲከ ፡ ወትደነግፅ ፡ ለሊከ ፡ መዐልተ ፡ [ወሌሊተ ፡] ወኢትትአመን ፡
                  በሕይወትከ ።
verses.translation: And thy life shall be in suspense before thine eyes; and thou shalt be afraid by day and by night, and thou shalt have no assurance of thy life.

translations.lxx: And thy life shall be in suspense before thine eyes; and thou shalt be afraid by day and by night, and thou shalt have no assurance of thy life.
translations.kjv: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
translations.ron: Viaţa ta va fi mereu în primejdie înaintea ochilor tăi; vei tremura ziua şi noaptea şi nu vei fi sigur de viaţa ta.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται ἡ ζωή σου κρεμαμένη ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου· καὶ φοβηθήσῃ ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς, καὶ οὐ πιστεύσεις τῇ ζωῇ σου.

verses.geez:
ለእመ ፡ ጸብሐ ፡ ትብል ፡ እፎ ፡ እንጋ ፡ ይመሲ ፡ ወለእመ ፡ መስየ ፡ ትብል ፡ እፎ ፡ ይጸብሕ ፡ እምነ ፡ ፍርሀተ ፡
                  ልብ ፡ ዘትደነግፅ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ዘያስተርእየከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዕይንቲከ ፡ ወዘትሬኢ ።
verses.translation: In the morning thou shalt say, Would it were evening! and in the evening thou shalt say, Would it were morning! for the fear of thine heart with which thou shalt fear, and for the sights of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

translations.lxx: In the morning thou shalt say, Would it were evening! and in the evening thou shalt say, Would it were morning! for the fear of thine heart with which thou shalt fear, and for the sights of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
translations.kjv: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
translations.ron: De tremurul inimii tale, de care vei fi cuprins, şi de cele ce vei vedea cu ochii tăi, dimineaţa vei zice: O, de ar veni seara! Iar seara vei zice: O, de ar veni ziua!
translations.grk: Τὸ πρωῒ ἐρεῖς, πῶς ἂν γένοιτο ἑσπέρα· καὶ τὸ ἑσπέρας ἐρεῖς, πῶς ἂν γένοιτο πρωΐ· ἀπὸ τοῦ φόβου τῆς καρδίας σου ἃ φοβηθήσῃ, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ὁραμάτων τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου ὧν ὄψῃ.

verses.geez:
ወያገብአከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ በአሕማር ፡ ወእንተ ፡ ምድርኒ ፡ በእግር ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ዘአቤ ፡ ኢትደግሙ ፡
                  እንከ ፡ ርእዮታ ፡ ዓዲ ፡ ወትከውኑ ፡ በህየ ፡ አግብርተ ፡ ወአእማተ ፡ ለፀርክሙ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘያስተምሕረክሙ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord shall bring thee back to Egypt in ships, by the way of which I said, Thou shalt not see it again; and ye shall be sold there to your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and none shall buy you.

translations.lxx: And the Lord shall bring thee back to Egypt in ships, by the way of which I said, Thou shalt not see it again; and ye shall be sold there to your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and none shall buy you.
translations.kjv: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
translations.ron: Şi te va întoarce Domnul în Egipt, în corăbii pe calea aceea de care ţi-a zis: "Să nu o mai vezi!"; şi acolo vă veţi da spre vânzare vrăjmaşilor voştri robi şi roabe şi nu va fi cine să vă cumpere".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀποστρέψει σε Κύριος εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἐν πλοίοις, ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἡ· εἶπα, οὐ προσθήσῃ ἔτι ἰδεῖν αὐτήν· καὶ πραθήσεσθε ἐκεῖ τοῖς ἐχθροῖς ὑμῶν εἰς παῖδας καὶ παιδίσκας, καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ κτώμενος.

verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ኪዳን ፡ ዘአዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትካየዶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡
                  በምድረ ፡ ሞአብ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ዝክቱ ፡ ኪዳን ፡ ዘተካየዶሙ ፡ በኮሬብ ።
